published_source: Figure 1A of the article is graphical (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2023.03143.txt, Eq. (2), coefficients relative to the adoption year). published_coef (Nov 2 audit) = equal-weight average of Pst1..Pst9 from the authors' do-file re-run in Stata MP 16 (~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2023.03143/authors_fig_t2.log), authors' normalization (rel 0 omitted); delta-method robust SE of that average from the fixest reproduction = 0.01214579 (not published). Nov 2 summary rule (team-lead: summaries average every reported bin, endpoint bins included): published_coef is now the equal-weight average of event years 1..9 and the accumulated +10 bin (all plotted in Figure 1) in the authors' normalization, -0.1354204 (delta-method SE 0.012545, hetero); the previous value -0.11730809 is kept in published_coef_1_9. Pre-summary average 0.04430633.

authors_code.source: Bai Ru 2024.do Figure block re-run in Stata MP 16 (work copy ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2023.03143/authors_fig_t2.do); fixest reproduces all 20 coefficients and robust SEs to 8 decimals and N exactly
authors_code.reference_period: event year 0 (ETS launch year) omitted; Pre10 = rel <= -10, Pst10 = rel >= 10

event_structure.source: Bai Ru 2024.do lines 117-121 (reg LogGHG CarbonExchange_dummy_Pre10..Pre1 Pst1..Pst10 $Control _I*, robust): PreK = K years before ETS launch, PstK = K years after, Pre10/Pst10 = 10 or more years before/after; the launch year (rel 0) is omitted (article Eq. (2): 'We exclude the year of ETS adoption'). Shipped dummies equal 1{year - g_ets = k} with the endpoint bins (verified, replication log); sample years 2000-2020 consecutive, g_ets in sample (2005-2015), so rel = t - g. Nothing uncovered. Endpoint bins excluded from the summaries; post summary = Pst1..Pst9, pre = Pre9..Pre1.
event_structure.verified: fixest feols(y ~ bins + 10 controls | country + year, vcov = hetero) on the authors' sample (N = 1717) reproduces the authors' 20 coefficients (authors_fig_t2.log, Stata re-run) to 4.9e-09 and robust SEs to 5.0e-09; post average (rel 1..9, ref 0) = -0.11730809 (delta-method robust SE 0.01214579) Nov 2 summary rule: with the reported endpoint bins added to the summaries, the authors'-normalization post average is -0.1354204 (SE 0.012545) and the pre average 0.04430633 (scratchpad/meta3/rule2/).
event_structure.summary_rule: Nov 2 rule: a bin is summarized iff the paper reports its coefficient, open endpoint bins included (Figure 1 plots event years -10..10 (Pre10/Pst10 are the accumulated end bins)).

replication_status: exact (vs authors' code re-run; published figure values not available to compare)
notes: CONTROLS ANALYSIS (PROTOCOL 5c). Event study of log GHG emissions on ETS launch: reg LogGHG CarbonExchange_dummy_Pre10..Pre1 Pst1..Pst10 $Control _I* (xi i.year i.Country_id), robust; sample 2000-2020, 100 countries. Only violation: ten time-varying macro controls ($Control), entered linearly. Onset g_ets = first year with ETS = 1 (absorbing, no switch-offs); 7 cohorts in the sample (2005: 23 EU countries; 2007: 2; 2008: 3; 2009: 1; 2010: 1; 2013: 3; 2015: 1); no always-treated countries; about 65 percent of countries never treated. The authors' endpoint bins (<= -10, >= 10) are reproduced by event_pre_min = -9 and event_post_max = 9. DEVIATIONS: (1) run_spec normalizes on event year -1, the authors on event year 0; the model is the same reparameterization, so the run_spec TWFE post average (rel 0..9) equals the authors' path re-centred on rel -1 (authors_code implied_post_avg). (2) Published SEs are heteroskedasticity-robust, not clustered; run_spec clusters by country. (3) Panel is unbalanced after listwise deletion of missing controls/outcome, so the CSA step uses the composition-fixed cells and ignores the controls (controls_ignored). preferred = false because the paper's headline estimates are the static Table 2 (not eligible: two lead dummies ETS_Pre1/ETS_Pre2). in_abstract_intro unverified (no article text). NOV 2 AUDIT (event_structure): event_structure keeps the authors' reference (launch year, rel 0) and endpoint bins (<= -10, >= 10); the deviation (1) re-normalization to rel -1 is superseded. published_coef filled with the Pst1..Pst9 average in the authors' normalization.
